offering_description.value: Provides shared services to colleges and universities, including program design and student support for campus and online degree programs. Its healthcare education services help universities deliver programs that combine online learning, hands-on instruction, and clinical experience.

quotes.quote: GCE is a shared services partner dedicated to serving colleges and universities. GCE can design programs that serve your diverse student body on campus or online at the undergraduate, master, and doctoral program levels.
